worlds.report:
PANDEMIC WORLD REPORT — Day 20

One isolated region, Riverton: 5,000 people, no travel in or out.
Disease model: SIR (susceptible -> infectious -> recovered; no deaths). Infected people are infectious for 10 days on average, then recover with permanent immunity. Each person has about 6 contacts per day. The simulation is agent-based and stochastic.
  Transmission probability per contact per day 0.030 (basic reproduction number R0 ≈ 1.8); 28 people infectious at day 0.

Observed cumulative infections at the end of each day (people ever infected, including those infectious at day 0):
  Riverton: d0:32 -> d5:66 -> d10:118 -> d15:225 -> d20:431   (day 20: 327 currently infectious)
worlds.intervention: Riverton will run a vaccination campaign on day 21 (95% efficacy, 90% coverage): on day 21, 90% of Riverton's population is vaccinated, and vaccination reduces a vaccinated person's probability of infection per exposure by 95%.
